purpose: Test whether strictly-prior team score-compression and low-event history derived from existing score labels adds match-specific Draw information beyond the existing strength/balance representation, on a ninth deterministic 100-match sample disjoint from all previously consumed R39U-R40B samples.

score_state.scope: strictly-prior same-competition score outcomes only; all matches on the same date are featurized before any same-date score updates team state
score_state.feature_row_eligibility: at least one strictly-prior same-competition scored match must exist; zero-prior competition rows are excluded from model fitting
score_state.no_team_history_behavior: after competition score prior exists, an empty team-specific window shrinks exactly to the strictly-prior competition mean/rate; no target/future score is used

model.family: binary Draw logistic from score-compression features + unchanged conditional H/A lane
model.standardization: median/IQR fitted on each target's strictly-prior feature-eligible same-competition training rows only
model.solver: deterministic Newton/IRLS with backtracking line search
model.conditional_HA: exact R39W conditional Home-vs-Away logistic on non-draws, L2=10
model.mapping: P(D)=score-compression Draw logistic; remaining mass split by conditional H/A probability; exact H/D/A probability conservation
model.top1: argmax H/D/A with no Draw tie preference

baseline.name: exact R39W two-stage linear balance/intensity Draw model plus conditional H/A lane

frozen_gate.if_pass: Authorizes only time-ordered rolling evaluation of this exact score-compression architecture; no formal promotion.
frozen_gate.if_fail: Stop score-compression route; no post-result window/L2/threshold tuning on this sample.
